prompt: Notes I add on the Reports page do not appear until I leave the page and come back.

truth.summary: The hand-written reports reducer pushes the note onto state.notes and returns the same state object, so combineReducers keeps the old root state, no subscriber is notified, and the connected list never re-renders.

referenceAnswer.cause: REPORT_NOTE_ADDED mutates state.notes with push and returns the same state, so the store reference never changes and connected components are not notified.

decoyAnswers.cause: ReportNotesList is a PureComponent, so it blocks the update.
The composer does not dispatch the action.

genieEvidence.notes: Genie's Redux collector proves it. redux_actions reports NOTE_ADDED with rootStateChanged false, changedSlices [] and mutation.status 'detected' at ['reports','notes'] (length-changed): the reducer changed the existing array in place and returned the same state, so no subscriber was notified. redux_state shows the note in the store and ReportNotesList has no render. After the fix the action has no mutation, changes the reports slice, and the connect() wrapper's external-store cause names reports/NOTE_ADDED. That link is inferred: the wrapper sits under ReportsPage's connect(), which can relay a change from its own layout effect, so Genie cannot prove by ordering that no earlier action is the cause.
